correctness.rationale: For odd prime p and nonzero weights, the formal real quadratic extension Q=1/2Σ[(u_j−u_{j+a})²+(u_j−u_{j+b})²−(u_j−u_{j+a+b})²] diagonalizes by additive characters. With normalized a=1 and c=−b/a, signs of nonzero Fourier eigenvalues are sign cos(π(k−[ck]_p)/p); p odd excludes equality/extra nullspace. If c∈{1,2,2^{-1}}, every sign positive. Otherwise c≤(p−1)/2 after k=1 restriction and k=floor((p−1)/c) yields a strict negative mode; positive trace gives an opposite sign. Checked exact residue inequalities across 45 odd primes <200, 556,656 prime-ratio mode instances, including even negative multiplicity. Proof, not finite check, establishes all p. This does not assert realized Hilbert-scheme multiplicities.
